stories.title: MAX17048 SOC% calibration protocol + scripts (F-048)
acceptance: a documented calibration protocol + script (offices/tuner/scripts/ or scripts/) runs a controlled charge/discharge learning cycle and captures register SOC% vs a known reference
output feeds the US-234/US-427 cold-start guard threshold (the ~3-min window) with real data, not a guessed constant
bench-verifiable on the UPS-drain rig; results documented
ruff check passes on any .py

validationCriteria.action: run the calibration cycle on the UPS-drain rig
validationCriteria.outcome: register SOC% is captured vs the reference; the cold-start window threshold is set from measured data

stories.goal: As the CIO, I want a repeatable SOC% calibration/learning run for the MAX17048, so the _soc_pct values recorded (Sprint 52) are trustworthy despite the cold-start mis-read.

stories.title: drive_detect idle-poll gap -- residual engine-on miss (F-049, verify-first + A-9 guardrails)
acceptance: VERIFY-FIRST: US-242/B-049 already built idle->active-poll escalation on engine-on (alternator BATTERY_V + RPM-probe injection, core.py:356/1200/1212) -- root-cause the RESIDUAL gap on the live Pi, do NOT re-solve; state the specific mechanism that still misses
fix the residual gap so an engine-on transition promotes poll cadence + fires drive_start within the expected window
A-9 guardrail (a): must NOT regress US-388's close-guarantee (evaluateTimeouts/deadline-anchored) or the drive_id NULL-latch
A-9 guardrail (b): fold into the A-9 IRL re-gate (missed-start-in-idle-poll = another drive-lifecycle failure to exercise)
unit test simulating idle->engine-on; ruff check passes

validationCriteria.action: re-query the live Pi against the existing US-242/B-049 escalation
validationCriteria.outcome: the specific residual miss mechanism is identified (not a re-solve of the shipped escalation)

validationCriteria.action: run the drive-lifecycle regression after the fix
validationCriteria.outcome: US-388 close-guarantee + drive_id NULL-latch not regressed; idle->engine-on fires drive_start

stories.goal: As the system, I want engine-on reliably detected in the idle-poll path, so a drive is not missed when the poll loop is in its idle cadence.

acceptance: VERIFY-FIRST (Atlas: almost certainly DONE -- lifecycle.py:1873 US-243 power_log write path active + US-412 synced): re-query the live Pi, confirm power_log populating; if live+healthy CLOSE WITH EVIDENCE (row counts + recent timestamps), no code
only if a real gap remains: activate/repair the UpsMonitor->power_log write path (VCELL/SOC/CRATE/power_source per poll)
ruff check passes on any .py

validationCriteria.outcome: rows present + current -> close-with-evidence; OR a real gap is documented + fixed

stories.goal: As the system, I want the UpsMonitor readings written to power_log, so power history is captured.

stories.title: drain_event close-on-poweroff -- verify (F-062, likely MOOT)
acceptance: VERIFY-FIRST (Atlas: very likely MOOT -- startDrainEvent/endDrainEvent have 0 production callers, hardware_manager.py:73; nothing opens a drain during operation): confirm 0 production callers + no stuck-open drain_event rows post-poweroff -> CLOSE AS MOOT WITH EVIDENCE, no code

only if a real open-path is found (unexpected): a targeted close in ShutdownSequencer (power_watch/controller.py) -- but flag PM/Atlas first (it contradicts the retired ladder + the BL-015 ~10s-shutdown-not-real-drain semantic), do NOT build unflagged
ruff check passes on any .py

validationCriteria.action: grep production startDrainEvent callers + query stuck-open drain_event rows
validationCriteria.outcome: 0 callers + 0 stuck rows -> closed as moot with evidence; OR a real open-path is flagged before any code

stories.goal: As the system, I want drain_event rows to close cleanly on poweroff, so drain records are not left open.

stories.title: Derived signals -- acceleration + estimated distance from speed+time (F-106, server-side)
acceptance: compute acceleration (delta-speed/delta-time) + estimated distance (integral speed*dt) SERVER-SIDE (Atlas-confirmed: B-104 server-is-sole-analytics-writer; src/server/analytics/ per-drive compute) -- NOT Pi
derived values stored/queryable per drive; guard against divide-by-zero / time gaps
unit tests against canned speed/time series; ruff check passes

validationCriteria.action: run the server analytics compute against a canned speed/time series
validationCriteria.outcome: per-drive acceleration + estimated distance computed correctly; gaps/zero-dt handled, no crash

stories.goal: As the CIO, I want acceleration + estimated distance derived from the existing speed+time stream, so drives have richer motion context without new PIDs.
